requirements.proposition_to_establish: Screening of plants or plant products, if carried out at the establishment, is conducted in a way that is appropriate to manage the risk of contamination by large contaminants.
requirements.criterion_quote: manage the risk of contamination by large contaminants

query_sources.quote: If screening of the plants or plant products is carried out at the establishment, it must be carried out in a way that is appropriate:
to manage the risk of contamination by large contaminants; and
to ensure that any large contaminants are removed from the plants or plant products.
manage the risk of contamination by large contaminants
